# vngcloud_vdb_kafka_user (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vngcloud_vdb_kafka_user" "app_user" {
  cluster_id  = vngcloud_vdb_kafka_cluster.kafka.id
  name        = "app-user"
  mtls_authen = false
  sasl_authen = true

  produce_topic_names = [vngcloud_vdb_kafka_topic.events.name]
  consume_all         = true
}

resource "vngcloud_vdb_kafka_user" "admin_user" {
  cluster_id  = vngcloud_vdb_kafka_cluster.kafka.id
  name        = "admin-user"
  sasl_authen = true
  admin_all   = true
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- **cluster_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The ID of the Kafka cluster that owns this user. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **name** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The user name. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **mtls_authen** (Bool, Optional, ForceNew):
    - Enable mTLS authentication for this user. Defaults to `false`. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **sasl_authen** (Bool, Optional, ForceNew):
    - Enable SASL authentication for this user. Defaults to `false`. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **produce_topic_names** (List of String, Optional):
    - Topics this user has Produce permission on. Ignored if `produce_all = true`.

- **produce_all** (Bool, Optional):
    - Grant Produce permission on all topics. Defaults to `false`.

- **consume_topic_names** (List of String, Optional):
    - Topics this user has Consume permission on. Ignored if `consume_all = true`.

- **consume_all** (Bool, Optional):
    - Grant Consume permission on all topics. Defaults to `false`.

- **produce_consume_topic_names** (List of String, Optional):
    - Topics this user has both Produce and Consume permissions on. Ignored if `produce_consume_all = true`.

- **produce_consume_all** (Bool, Optional):
    - Grant both Produce and Consume permissions on all topics. Defaults to `false`.

- **admin_topic_names** (List of String, Optional):
    - Topics this user has Admin permission on. Ignored if `admin_all = true`.

- **admin_all** (Bool, Optional):
    - Grant Admin permission on all topics. Defaults to `false`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to all arguments above, the following attributes are exported:

- **id** (String) The ID of the user.

- **status** (String, Computed):
    - The current status of the user (e.g. `ACTIVE`, `CREATING`, `UPDATING`, `ERROR`, ...).

- **old_status** (String, Computed):
    - The previous status of the user before the most recent transition.

- **portal_user_id** (Int, Computed):
    - The portal user ID that owns this Kafka user.

- **created_at** (String, Computed):
    - The time when the user was created.

## Import

Kafka users can be imported using the format `<cluster_id>/<user_id>`:

```shell
terraform import vngcloud_vdb_kafka_user.app_user clus-51fd625a-06f2-4e5f-8508-98c4ab7221e5/user-abc12345-...
```
